description.to:
Outcome: What must be true: a reader who signs in on two tenants' sites gets two unrelated reader ids (pairwise subject per site), handles are unique per site, and no tenant's export or files carry a cross-site identifier. Today the pairwise siteSubject comes from Prospectus per product (one product per site); with one shared product this needs a per-deployment subject from Prospectus (question 5 of PPY-6d9a6d).

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/plugins/reader-steering (ReaderProfile, ReaderHandle), lib/prospectus-session.ts, Prospectus reader sign-in (PPY-1546fc, PPY-445274).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/reader-identity-per-site.feature):
Scenario: One person is two unrelated readers on two sites
    Given Ada signs in as a reader on "alpha" and on "beta"
    When both tenants export their reader data
    Then the two reader ids differ and nothing in either export links them

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-6d9a6d, PPY-ef2c57. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-1546fc.

Testing: Behave with a fake Prospectus.
Rollout: With reader features on the shared stack.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: Prospectus cannot give per-deployment subjects soon. Mitigation: reader features stay off for shared tenants until it can (they are not needed for TI's move).

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
